newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares climb further, close at new record.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares climb further, close at new record.

text.p: Estonia's seemingly unstoppable share market showed further gains by the close on Tuesday although some dealers said the bourse may be entering a stabilisation period after its prolonged bull run.
Trade on the main list was 146.4 million kroons and the Talse index rose 1.52 percent to yet another record of 389.33.
Both Hansapank and Hoiupank, which have consistently led the market, hit new highs.
Hansa rose 1.50 kroons to 222.50 while Hoiu added 5.85 kroons to 236.75.
Dealers were mixed on the outlook for the shares, with some expecting a significant downward correction while others said the shares were at a fair value.
"This could be a new level for the banks with prices holding around this level," one dealer said.
Local investors remain upbeat and are ready to hold on to their stocks and not bail out.

"I don't see any reason to get out of Hansapank, the price may not double by the end of the year but the stock is worth holding on to for now despite experts saying that the stock is over-valued," one active investor told Reuters.
In Helsinki, Hansapank was also traded up to 82 markka after opening at 80 markka and reaching 83.30 markka during the day.
Hansapank released its July net income at 37 million kroons and said its assets reached 9.04 billion kroons.
"All the bank results were good, with Hoiupank's the most impressive," one dealer said.
Hoiupank closed 5.85 kroons higher at 236.75 kroons after trading 37.7 million kroons. Hoiupank released a profit result of 21.1 million kroons for July.
Uhispank released its July results after trading finished with a profit of 18.1 million kroons. Uhispank turned over 20.5 million kroons to be two higher at 75.75 kroons.
Norma made its debut on the main list today after moving from the free market. It gained 2.55 kroons to close at 93.50 kroons on trade of 12.9 million kroons.
Estonian Security Service started trading on the secondary list to rise to 81.75 kroons. The price of the stock during its share issue was 57 kroons.
